title: Institutional website
slide_intent: Hold diverse research content within a stable editorial structure so readers can explore without losing institutional context.
strategic_value: A consistent header and content grid can connect changing research stories to the lab.
demonstration: A browser view combines the lab signature, navigation, an orange lead story and multiple text columns.
practical_value: Study how a restrained identity supports varied imagery and information density.
